# مستر طنز / MRTanz.ir

## About

MRTanz.ir (مستر طنز) is a Persian-language comedy and entertainment website. It hosts a curated archive of funny video clips, stand-up comedy, dubbed comedy, short comedy clips, user-submitted jokes, playlists, and independent comedy articles.

## Content

- **Video Archive**: Stand-up comedy, dubbed clips, short clips, and curated videos from the YouTube channel "مستر طنز"
- **Joke Archive**: 80 user-submitted Persian jokes, categorized by type (short, situational, life advice, etc.)
- **Playlists**: Themed collections of comedy videos
- **Articles**: Independent comedy and entertainment articles in Persian
- **About**: Information about the site and its mission to promote laughter and positivity

## Official Website

https://mrtanz.ir

## Language

Persian (Farsi), RTL layout
